methodology: Built entirely from SEC EDGAR full-text search (https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index) for 8-K filings containing 'Amended and Restated Credit Agreement', 'Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement', and 'First Amendment to Amended and Restated Credit Agreement' phrasing, filed 2024-06-01 through 2025-12-31, plus each candidate's own SEC EDGAR company-submissions metadata (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json) to confirm company identity/SIC/tickers. No exhibit/agreement TEXT was opened at pool-construction time - only search-hit metadata (issuer, CIK, accession number, filing date, SIC, item codes) and each company's own submissions index (form types, dates, item codes). Excluded issuers (FWRG/LSB/CONMED/DSGR/Coherent/Matthews/Riot Platforms) never appeared in these searches; none of the 9 pool members appear anywhere in this repository (independently grep-verified across lib/ and tests/ - the handful of substring hits found were confirmed false positives, e.g. 'NACCO' matching inside the unrelated word 'unaccounted').
poolOrderingForDeterminism: Ascending by CIK (a fixed, objective, pre-existing SEC identifier - never an ordering chosen after seeing results) - this exact order is what the deterministic selection formula in 02-selection.json indexes into.
